title: A fix check on a replacement PR with an identical tree may name the replaced PR's newest record
why: merge --fix-check needs an earlier record on the same PR, so a replacement PR with an identical tree (the remedy for a refused force push, or for check_red_run on a pushed commit) re-runs a whole chain. Today #2139 and #2140 (lane notes-fix-page, replacing #1581 and #2021) need six reviews of unchanged code (coordinator, 10:29 CST Nov 8).
note: Filed 10:31 CST Nov 8 from the coordinator; a gap fix under item 410 a, merge-tool topic, its own lane, which the coordinator starts. Fix: the fix check on the new PR may name the replaced PR's newest record, and the tool proves the empty tree diff itself. Related, not the same: record-replacement-pr-rounds (ready, #1773), which carries the rounds owed. Doing 10:35 CST Nov 8 in lane session_013NEJL1WFQtTFeWPY7r1qYP (coordinator 10:32 CST). Sighting for the lane to confirm scope (lane notes-fix-large-3, session_013NEJL1rKuNDSwMxwArjXHb): on #1706 two empty Drops-lines commits after a record with a Fix check line left a tree-identical head that needs a fresh chain; its ask: the refusal names that cost, and a record is accepted when the new head's tree equals the newest record's head tree. Related: step record-rounds-name-own-head (803) refuses mismatched heads and keeps this step's identical-tree case as an exception; incident #2235 at 660db61b0 carried #1864's rounds 1-3.
